title: Trans-Epithelial Exposure Model (TEEM) - Epithelial Cells and Fibroblasts
protocol: Pre-warm supplemented MEM growth medium in a 37°C water bath and pre-warm PBS and trypsin aliquot at room temperature for about 30 minutes.
Trypsinize, collect, and pellet IMR90 cells at 1,000 x g at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 12 mL of supplemented growth medium.
Triturate at least four times to thoroughly break up clumped cells.
Prepare a 1:1 dilution in Trypan Blue (50 μL Trypan blue + 50 μL cell suspension) in an Eppendorf tube.
Count cells that exclude Trypan Blue on a hemocytometer, count both sides of two independent loads for four counts total.
Mix thoroughly by inversion the diluted cell suspension in a sterile bottle or tube.
Dispense the diluted cell suspension into each collagen-coated well, using 2 mL for 6-well plates and 800 μL for 12-well plates.
Incubate the cells in a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO₂ and 20% O₂ for one day before combining them with 16HBE cells.
Pre-warm complete MEM growth medium, PBS in a 37°C water bath and trypsin aliquot at room temperature.
Trypsinize, collect and pellet 16HBE cells at 1,000 x g at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in complete growth medium.
Triturate at least four times to thoroughly break up clumped cells.
Prepare a 1:5 dilution of cells in PBS (800 μL PBS + 200 μL cell suspension).
Count cells on a hemocytometer.
Record the number of cells obtained per plate.
Calculate the number of population doublings that occurred during the last passage.
Dilute cells to 8.0 x 10^5 cells/mL in complete growth medium.
Mix thoroughly by inversion.
Dispense 2 mL of diluted cell suspension into each collagen-coated 24mm insert.
Dispense 500 μL of diluted cell suspension into each collagen-coated 12mm insert.
Dispense 2 mL of complete growth medium to the basolateral compartment for each well containing a 24mm insert.
Dispense 800 μL of complete growth medium to the basolateral compartment for each well containing a 12mm insert.
Check that there are no air bubbles trapped underneath the insert membrane.
Incubate in a humidified 37°C incubator with 5% CO2 and 20% O2 for 1 day.
Aspirate the medium from the basolateral compartment of the wells containing Transwell inserts seeded with 16HBE cells.
Transfer Transwell inserts with 16HBE cells into the wells containing IMR90 cells without changing the culture medium on top of either cell type.
Incubate in a humidified 37°C incubator with 5% CO2 and 20% O2 for 1 day until exposure to diesel exhaust particulates (DEP).
Pre-warm basal medium (MEM + glutaMAX with 1X penicillin/streptomycin) in a 37°C water bath.
Thaw frozen PM preparation and dilute to desired concentration in basal medium. Vortex thoroughly.
Aspirate the medium from the apical compartment of the Transwell inserts.
Replace aspirated medium with either vehicle (basal medium) or diluted PM suspension in the appropriate volume: 1 mL/insert for 24mm inserts (6 well), 250 μL/insert for 12mm inserts (12 well).
Return to the humidified 37°C incubator for the desired exposure duration.
Harvest VEH and PM exposure samples for RNA or whole cell protein immediately after desired exposure duration.
Remove Transwell inserts from the exposure plate.
Blot basal surfaces with Kimwipes and transfer into new, clean wells.
Aspirate the medium from the apical compartment.
Rinse the apical surface with 1 mL of PBS for 24mm inserts or 500 μL of PBS for 12mm inserts. Aspirate the PBS wash.
Add 300 μL of RNA lysis buffer (with 1% 2-mercaptoethanol) and pipette up and down to distribute the lysis buffer across the membrane surface.
Transfer the lysate from each sample into individual Eppendorf tubes.
Use cell scrapers to dislodge cells for 24mm inserts.
Store the samples at -80°C until RNA isolation.
Aspirate the medium from the basolateral compartment.
Add 300 μL of RNA lysis buffer (with 1% 2-mercaptoethanol) for 6 well plates or 200 μL for 12 well plates, pipette up and down to distribute the lysis buffer across the well surface.
Transfer the lysate from each sample into individual Eppendorf tubes.
Use cell scrapers to dislodge cells for 6 well plates.
Store the samples at -80°C until RNA isolation.
